mapper.select: /*获取最新的留痕表信息*/ with tempA as( select a.*,rank() over(partition by a.workflow_id order by a.HIS_NO desc) as rank from sys_wfl_business_node A inner join sys_wfl_business_list B on A.workflow_id = B.workflow_id and b.process_state = 'BACK' ), /*根据sys_wfl_business_node表中信息过滤掉退回后再保存的流程*/ filter as( select C.seq_no workflow_id from tempA A inner join sys_wfl_business_list C on c.workflow_id = a.workflow_id where A.rank = 2 and exists( select 1 from tempA B where B.rank = 1 and B.workflow_id = A.workflow_id and b.node_id = a.node_id ) ), TEMP AS ( SELECT * FROM( select workflow_id from filter) ) WHERE rank = 1 ), /*fin_trade_product去重,该表可能存在相同的finprod_id，而且此次查询只需要该表中的finprod_id字段*/ ftp as( select distinct finprod_id from fin_trade_product ) select nvl(fp.FINPROD_ID,ftp.finprod_id) finprodId, nvl(fp.finprod_name,fp.finprod_abbr) finprodName, pp.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, a.tradeId, launchUser, nextUser, replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(temp.business_data,'"seqno":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"seqno":"',''),'"','') tradeId, replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(temp.business_data,'"busiId":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"busiId":"',''),'"','') busiId, replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(temp.business_data,'"busiName":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"busiName":"',''),'"','') busiName,
